_doc: #1961 folder-scoped README trios: for each target the engine (0_registry/render-repo-readmes.js) renders README.html, README.canvas and README.md with the same sections scoped to <path> of <repo>, into dist/<repo>~<path>/ ; deploy-readmes.sh copies them into <path>/ of the clone. Cloud Me Proj > Wiki pages point at these folders.

targets.title: Cloud Wiki: Modern Science
targets.description: Modern Science pages of Cloud Wiki: Science, Humanities, Arts and Explore, one folder per topic.

targets.description: Arcanum Science pages of Cloud Wiki, after the Esoteric Arcanum master taxonomy.
